# storeshots

> Offline CLI (and MCP server) that generates store-ready App Store and Google Play screenshots from raw app screenshots: device frames, benefit headlines with locale-correct casing, brand backgrounds, and exact store dimensions. It is deterministic, has no API keys, and makes no network calls. Install it with npm as `storeshots-mcp`; the command is `storeshots`.

The tool does the pixels. You, the agent, do the copy: choose one benefit per screen, write a short verb plus descriptor headline, and translate it idiomatically. Never generate or edit the output images any other way.

## Workflow

1. `npx -y --package=storeshots-mcp storeshots init --langs en,tr --bg "#E31837"` finds `./screenshots` (or pass `--screens <dir>`). It writes `storeshots.json` with TODO headlines and adds a storeshots section to the project's AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md.
2. Replace every TODO in `storeshots.json`. The build refuses to run while any are left.
3. `storeshots build` renders every screen × preset × language to `output/<lang>/<preset>/<lang>_NN.png`. Later builds re-render only what changed and remove the outputs of deleted screens.
4. `storeshots validate output` checks store rules before upload. It exits 1 on failure.

Add `--json` to any command for machine-readable output. Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 render or validation failure, 2 bad usage or config. Config errors list every problem with its path, e.g. `screens[2].copy.tr: missing`.

## storeshots.json

```json
{
  "background": "#E31837",
  "presets": ["ios-phone", "android-phone"],
  "languages": ["en", "tr"],
  "outputDir": "output",
  "variant": "text-top",
  "screens": [
    { "screenshot": "screenshots/home.png", "copy": { "en": ["Track", "your daily mood"], "tr": ["İzle", "günlük ruh halini"] } },
    { "screenshot": "screenshots/{platform}/stats.png", "variant": "tilted", "copy": { "en": ["Discover", "weekly insights"], "tr": ["Keşfet", "haftalık içgörüler"] } }
  ],
  "featureGraphic": { "screen": 1 },
  "showcase": true
}
```

- Presets: `ios-phone` 1320×2868, `android-phone` 1080×1920, `ipad-13` 2064×2752, `android-tablet` 1600×2560. Play's 1024×500 feature graphic comes from `featureGraphic`, not `presets`.
- Copy is `["verb", "descriptor"]` or `{"verb", "descriptor"}` in natural case. storeshots uppercases it per locale.
- Screenshot paths are relative to the config and may use `{lang}`, `{preset}` and `{platform}` (ios/android), or an object keyed by preset id with a `"default"` fallback.
- `variant`: `text-top`, `text-bottom` or `tilted`, set for the whole set or per screen. Mix them across a set.
- Optional: `panorama: {"to": "#hex"}` (one gradient across all panels), a per-screen `background`, `frame` (custom device frame PNG plus screen rectangle), `noGradient`.

## Other commands

- `storeshots build --watch | --lang tr | --preset ios-phone | --dry-run | --force`
- `storeshots compose --preset ios-phone --bg "#E31837" --verb Track --desc "your mood" --screenshot raw.png -o out.png` renders one image without a config.
- `storeshots showcase -o strip.png output/en/ios-phone` stitches a preview strip.
- `storeshots presets` lists every preset with its dimensions.
